name: Multi-Channel Release & Update System
summary: Formalizes AutoIngest's release process into three isolated channels — Development (internal engineering builds, never published), RC/Preview (real tester acceptance before Stable, opt-in only), and Stable (the existing production release path, unchanged) — so a tester-facing build can exist without ever risking exposure to Stable users, and so a verified RC has an auditable, gated path to becoming the Stable release built from its exact source.
